# ManagedAgentMode

What a managed interaction's agent sees when its manager dispatches work to it.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"OneTime"` | A fresh start every dispatch: its own persona and the manager's message, nothing more. Kept for audit, never shown again. |
| `"Private"` | A conversation of its own with the manager, kept across dispatches: every message the manager sent it and every reply. |
| `"Group"` | The shared conversation: the manager's own words, the human's, and every dispatch to a group agent with its reply, like a round-robin where it speaks only when the manager hands it the turn. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`InteractionProcessManagedDispatch`](interaction-process-managed-dispatch.md)
- Inside [`ManagedInteractionAgentBinding`](managed-interaction-agent-binding.md)
